Q: Why is my BigQuery code saying it doesn't recognize a table name? A:

The problem is likely that you need to use the fully qualified table name, just as in the FROM and JOIN clauses.

ON modern-ellipse-438015-c0.Bellabeat.DailyActivity3.Id = modern-ellipse-438015-c0.Bellabeat.DailyActivity4.Id

To avoid having to repeat these long names, I recommend you assign aliases:

FROM modern-ellipse-438015-c0.Bellabeat.DailyActivity3 da3
JOIN modern-ellipse-438015-c0.Bellabeat.DailyActivity4 da4
ON da3.Id = da4.Id

Note also that it's not necessary to enclose the table name in backticks when it contains - characters.

Q: Is it necessary to execute two queries for pagination in CodeIgniter? A:

Yes, two query executions are required.

For maximum elegance, you can re-use clauses from the first query in the second query by explicitly not resetting the query builder cache.

  1. Set any filtering/grouping logic.
  2. Execute the row counting query (use false with count_all_results() to retain WHERE logic).
  3. Add clauses like SELECT, LIMIT, and OFFSET which wouldn't make sense with the earlier query.
  4. Execute the data fetching query without renominating the target table(s) or filtering logic.
public function getPaginatorResult(
    string $something,
    ?int $limit = null,
    ?int $offset = null
): array {
    return [
        'qualifyingTotal' => $this->db
            ->where('something', $something)
            ->count_all_results('the_table_name', false),
        'chunkOfQualifyingData' => $this->db
            ->get('', $limit, $offset)
            ->result(),
    ];
}

Your model method calling script can then access the 2-element array data to support pagination.

Pro-tip: Do not use num_rows() for this task. Using num_rows() means that you are counting the rows of a result set containing fetched data that you will not use (wasteful). When you want the qualifying row count, but do not need any actual columnar data, just call count_all_results().

Q: Git push failed with error: “GitLab: Author not member of team” A:

The problematic commit was made before your global user.email was correctly set, or when a local repository configuration defaulted to guessing your email using your system's username and hostname (logath-T460).

Git embeds the author email directly inside each commit, so changing git config now only affects future commits.

Run this command in your terminal:

git commit --amend --author="Sam Logan <SamLogan@mycompany.com>" --no-edit

If the incorrect email spans several commits, use an interactive rebase:

git rebase -i HEAD~N

After fixing the commit history locally, force-push the updated history to the remote repository (if you are the only one working on this branch):

git push origin <branch-name> --force-with-lease

Q: FCM v1 fid (Firebase Installation ID) target returns 404 UNREGISTERED on iOS, while the full registration token delivers A:

I have faced the same issue. The FID working on the firebase Compose notification but fails when sending to my web application, returning a 404. The FCM token works fine despite the deprecation warning. I decided to stick with getToken(on the client application - javascript) and setToken(on the server admin java SDK) despite warnings on both SDKs.

Q: Python script to download Barchart data is no longer working A:

bet it's actually dying on that XSRF token lookup with a keyerror before it even gets to the API call, so swap in cookies.get() and check the status code on that first request before anything else. also worth remembering that's a GET, and angular's xsrf stuff usually only cares about POST and PATCH, so even if you dig up a token there's no guarantee that's what's blocking you here. if there's a csrf meta tag sitting in the DOM somewhere don't assume it does the same job as the cookie, those are two different things and having one doesn't mean the other's satisfied. i'd also just leave the tradetime filter alone, that's been hardcoded since 2021 so it's not what suddenly broke on you. past that point i'd stop guessing and just watch the actual request go out in playwright, grab the json straight off the response event

Q: how to get the list of Function and Sub of a given module name in Excel VBA A:

I've written this long ago, ..., maybe of interest, ... (because today I've searched for this feature, then remembered ..., oh ...)
You have to add Extras->References->"Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications Extensibility Library ..."
(if you choose to export to file, seems to be in UTF-8)

' 04/28/02
' Versuch, die öffentlichen Methoden dieser Arbeitsmappe darzustellen
'
'Suffixes:
'& long
'! single
'# double
'@ currency
'% integer
'$ string

Private Declare Function GetComputerName _
    Lib "kernel32" Alias "GetComputerNameA" _
    (ByVal lpBuffer As String, lpnSize As Long) _
    As Long

'
'Gibt eine Auflistung der in einem Projekt enthaltenen Proceduren(Sub, Function) zurück
'20260901 !!! Extras -> Verweise -> Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications Extensibility Library ... !!!
Public Sub PrintProcedures()
    Dim c As VBComponents
    Set c = Application.ActiveWorkbook.VBProject.VBComponents
    
    'Pfad für Datei festlegen(d.h. aktuelles Arbeitsverzeichnis)
    Dim fPath As String
    fPath = ActiveWorkbook.Path & "\" & ActiveWorkbook.Name & "_Procedures.txt"

    Dim i, j, okC As Integer
    
    okC = MsgBox("Gefundene Prozeduren(Sub, Function)" & vbCrLf & _
                "in Datei exportieren?", vbOKCancel)
    If okC = vbOK Then
        'Rechner
        Dim hostName As String * 255, buffLen&
'       hostName = Space(255) 'Buffer
        buffLen = 255
        GetComputerName hostName, buffLen
        
        On Error GoTo nowWrite
        'falls Datei bereits vorhanden, diese löschen
        Set fs = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
        If fs.FileExists(fPath) Then
            Kill fPath
        End If
        Open fPath For Append As #1 'Datei zum Schreiben öffnen
        Print #1, "Erstellt: " & Now & vbCrLf & _
                    "User: " & Application.UserName & vbCrLf & _
                    "Host: " & hostName & vbCrLf
    End If
    
nowWrite:
    For i = 1 To c.Count
        Dim cM As CodeModule
        Dim cMName As String
        Dim cMLines As Integer
        Set cM = c.Item(i).CodeModule
        cMName = c.Item(i).Name
        cMLines = cM.CountOfLines
        Dim sDummy As String
        sDummy = cMName & " > lines: " & cMLines
        Debug.Print sDummy
        If okC = vbOK Then
            Print #1, sDummy 'Zeile an die geöffnete Datei anhängen
        End If
        'CodeModule enthält irgendeinen Code
        If cMLines > 0 Then
            For j = 1 To cMLines
                sDummy = cM.Lines(j, 1)
                'Zeile enthält Zeichen
                If Len(sDummy) > 0 Then
                    If InStr(1, sDummy, "Sub ", vbTextCompare) >= 1 Or _
                        InStr(1, sDummy, "Function ", vbTextCompare) >= 1 Then
                        sDummy = cMName & "(" & j & "): " & sDummy
                        Debug.Print sDummy
                        If okC = vbOK Then
                            Print #1, sDummy 'Zeile an die geöffnete Datei anhängen
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            Next j
        End If
        Debug.Print "" ' i.e. vbCrLf
        If okC = vbOK Then
            Print #1, "" 'leere Zeile
        End If
    Next i
    If okC = vbOK Then
        Close #1 'file
    End If
End Sub
